title: directory-permitted-listing
description: What read_directory_permitted_json returns: every entry under a root directory that the caller is permitted to see, by its path relative to the root, sorted by path. A symlink is listed as a link and never followed. size is a file's length in bytes; sha256 is present only when hashes were asked for. An entry the caller may not look into carries permitted: false and nothing beneath it is listed. vanished names every path the walk saw named and then found gone — the tree changed while it was being read — and is empty when nothing vanished.

permitted.description: This entry exists and is outside your access: nothing beneath it is listed. If the work needs what is in it, ask the user for access; do not change its permissions yourself.
